create_document_with_content: create a Document instance and append text content with optional tags
append_text_to_document: append text with tags to an existing Document instance
view_document_with_tags: create a filtered View of a Document by including or excluding tags
edit_document_context: use the edit context manager to modify a Document and commit changes
copy_and_clear_document: copy a Document and clear its contents to create an empty version
